data.body: **[P2] Build the failure response before reporting terminal `FAILED`.** `buildErrorObject` later invokes the user-provided `SerDes` to serialize the throwable. If that serialization fails, no failure response reaches the backend and Lambda retries, but invocation-end plugins have already observed `FAILED` and OTel may export a terminal Workflow span. Build the failure output under the delivery-failure guard first; if serialization fails, report `RETRYING`, rethrow it, and add a SerDes regression test.
